test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: AFHD is related to DIKG in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. Similarly GLNJ is related to JOQM. Following the same logic, MRTP is related to which of the following?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/362777f5fe816b11b0fcf3cca079ab0aaa57f7a8082227e6492639dd1a96b2c1.png] ​

**Logic: '3' is added to the positional value of each alphabet.**

AFHD is related to DIKG →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e6e5fb2d1e6943ddd238fbe088245869458c15aa1aba96b6e206018e642a3e9.png] 

GLNJ is related to JOQM →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db6a6ec672beb5de58c14b99dc947f8a840ddc079b0d7929a51626c7a9efd31b.png] 

Similarly, 'MRTP' will be related to:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5299dd60310b4986416718c026c8195788ac32bd3a5288943fefe78d35548eb3.png] 

Here, 'MRTP' is related to **'PUWS'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
